description: Creates a Stripe subscription checkout or recovery link for the authenticated company's owner after company proof has been submitted. Ownership is checked by the backend, including for delegated agents. First read subscription access and the offered plans; confirm the company's name, quoted price and billing period with the owner. billing_interval is month or year; empty defaults to month. The server chooses the Price. Changing period may expire the previous unpaid link. Existing outstanding subscriptions return an authenticated Lovie payment-page link for delegated agents, never a billing-portal credential or a second subscription. Return payment_url unchanged: new subscriptions open Stripe checkout; existing subscriptions open Lovie before the owner continues to Stripe. Never request card details or pay for them. A link is not payment confirmation: re-read subscription access afterward. Active or processing payments and uncertain status refuse another checkout.
name: equity_onboarding_get_payment_link
title: Recover Equity Subscription
